one=np.ones_like(eps)
def scan(f,grid):
    best=None
    for g in grid:
        X=np.column_stack([one]+f(g))
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
        r=sigma-X@c
        v=np.mean(r**2)/np.var(sigma)
        if best is None or v<best[0]: best=(v,g,np.round(c,4))
    return best
print('pow',scan(lambda p:[eps**p,T],np.linspace(0.3,3,271)))
